goal: Implement MusicClock per docs/08-AUDIO_DESIGN.md section 2: BPM-anchored beat clock with drift correction against Howler position, beat/bar/phase event emission, and ≤2ms anchor accuracy.
constraints: Events: 'beat' (fires once per beat boundary), 'bar' (every 4 beats by default; configurable), 'phase' (fires every animation frame the clock is updated).
Drift correction: reanchor() recomputes the clock's anchor so the next beat() value matches the externally-provided seekMs without going backwards.
beat() must be monotonic non-decreasing under all inputs except a fresh start().
Implementation must not depend on Howler at the module level — accept a position-getter function in the constructor for testability.
acceptance: Test: anchor accuracy ≤2ms when fed a perfect clock.
Test: msUntilBeat() returns correct value for sub-beat queries.
